filenameDivergence.rationale: Original include/uno/mapping.h C records and include/uno/mapping.hxx public inline C++ wrapper share a normalized stem but remain distinct source owners. The existing mapping.ts module represents mapping.h; preserving the .hxx discriminator before .ts gives the public wrapper a separate ESM identity and retains the upstream C-record versus C++-wrapper boundary.
